name: SPT X Public Company Limited
summary: SPT X Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the securities business and investment learning academy Thailand. The company invests in securities business; provides securities, future, and derivatives brokerage services; operates an institution learning academy related to investing in financial instruments, such as securities, derivatives, and others; and distributes and sells books related to investment. It also offers television services to digital system; and cryptocurrency or digital token brokerage services. The company was formerly known as News Network Corporation Public Company Limited and changed its name to SPT X Public Company Limited in January 2025. SP…
